answer: The admission bond is time locked for 21 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in ember, expire in falcon, and voyage lists each expiry. An farming party running 23 aliases thus needs 127 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1115 identities would post 2609 proofs and burn roughly 11 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
